senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Shobach, an Ammonite general.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:1">Sot. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בני … של ש׳</he> the Ammonites went into battle relying on the strength of Sh.

<cite ref="Sotah 42b:11">Ib. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>כתיב ש׳ וכתיב שופך</he> the name is once written Shobach (<cite ref="II Samuel 10:16">II Sam. X, 16</cite>), and once Shophach (<cite ref="I Chronicles 19:16">I Chr. XIX, 16</cite>); <he>חד אמר … עשוי כשׁוֹבָךְ</he> one authority says, his real name was Shophach, and he was called Shobach, because he was built like a dove-cote (of high stature, v. <cite ref="U00319">next w.</cite>), v. <cite ref="U01764"><he>שָׁפַךְ</he></cite>.
